title: How Do You Pay for a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: On chifbay.com you pay by card when you book, one price for the whole boat. On GetYourGuide, Viator or Click&Boat you pay the platform under its own rules.
heroAlt: A motor boat seen from directly above with five small guests on board and swimming nearby

images.prompt: Drone photo taken straight down from about 40 metres, early afternoon in August, over a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, stopped in deep blue-green water off Ribeira Brava on Madeira's south coast. Five small adult figures: two lying on the cushions at the bow, one sitting at the stern, two swimming a few metres from the boat, all far too small to recognise. At the top edge of the frame, the grey pebble beach of Ribeira Brava and a line of white foam. Realistic, natural colours, sharp shadows, no text.
